description.text: Tuition Standard (1) Chinese Government Scholarship students are free of charge. (2) The tuition for self-supporting students is ¥25,000/school year. Note: the tuition must be paid fully during registration at the beginning of each semester. Deadline of Application June 30 every year Commencement of teaching The first Monday of September

duration.text: The Animal Nutrition and Feed Science at Jiangnan University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. Health certificate Required during application.Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months)

requirements.text: 1. Applicants for Doctoral degree must have obtained Master’s Degree and be under the age of 40. 2. Be healthy
